$comment: Curated selection of images recovered from the old WordPress site.
out     — output stem under public/images/; the optimiser writes <out>.webp (max 1920px wide)
and <out>-800.webp, skipping any variant that would upscale the source.
exposure — optional brightness multiplier baked in (hero shots carry white text)
lossless — encode this entry as lossless WebP; for line-art diagrams, where lossy smears hairlines and small labels
noSmall  — write only the full-width file; for a diagram that is illegible at 800px
alt     — alt text, taken from the old site's caption and edited to sentence case.
Anything in the manifest but absent here was judged not worth shipping; docs/image-report.md says why.
